label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to openUrlByHostname(host) at line 45, constructing URLs with unvalidated hostnames. While isNonPublicAddress() checks resolveHost(), it only validates loopback/site/link/local addresses—not arbitrary domain names that could resolve to internal IPs. Attackers can bypass by providing domain names resolving to internal resources.

evidence.note: User param flows to openUrlByHostname(host) without blocking arbitrary domain names
resolveHost only checks basic address types, not full SSRF prevention
